trust_decision.summary: When the controller creates a Cluster for an agent-initiated ClusterRegistration, it decides which agent-supplied ClusterLabels are copied onto the Cluster. At the pinned commit every label is copied, including the reserved fleet.cattle.io/ and management.cattle.io/ keys that targeting trusts.

landing_point.why: The summary names agent-initiated registration and cluster labels. createOrGetCluster is the only place that copies request.Spec.ClusterLabels onto a new Cluster, and the package doc says it implements agent-initiated registration (controller.go:1).

fix_sites.entry_point: Kubernetes API create of a ClusterRegistration (fleet.cattle.io/v1alpha1) by the agent's registration-token identity, issued by `fleet-agent` register (internal/cmd/agent/register/register.go:189) and reconciled by OnChange -> createOrGetCluster (controller.go:160-166)
fix_sites.module_kind: controller handler (the real fix: sanitizeClusterLabels/isReservedLabel, fix.diff:34-74)
agent client; cosmetic change only, the literal is replaced by the constant CreatedByAgentPodLabel (fix.diff:13-14)

fix_sites.entry_point: Bundle targeting -> preprocessHelmValues (helm templating of ClusterLabels)
fix_sites.module_kind: target builder; cosmetic change only, literals replaced by prefix constants (fix.diff:257-258)
public API types package; constants only

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The changes to builder.go and register.go swap literals for constants and have no effect on behaviour (fix.diff:13-14, fix.diff:257-258). The only behavioural change is in createOrGetCluster.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found to dismiss. A solver could leave the fleet.cattle.io/created-by-agent-pod allow-list out, or drop only the management.cattle.io/cluster-display-name key named in the report, arguing that the rest of the fleet.cattle.io/* keys are overwritten by the controller anyway (controller.go:369 overwrites only fleet.cattle.io/cluster).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary agent-supplied labels such as env or team must still reach the Cluster, because clusterSelector targeting depends on them. The agent's own fleet.cattle.io/created-by-agent-pod label must also survive. A fix that drops all labels, or every fleet.cattle.io/* key, breaks one or the other.

O6_input_shapes: any other key under the management.cattle.io/ prefix
any key under the fleet.cattle.io/ prefix (including fleet.cattle.io/cluster, which is also overwritten at controller.go:369)
an empty or nil ClusterLabels map (must give an empty, non-nil map)

O7_producer.where: internal/cmd/controller/agentmanagement/controllers/clusterregistration/controller.go:343-388 (createOrGetCluster writes Cluster.Labels, which the targeting code reads at internal/cmd/controller/target/builder.go:73-79 and internal/cmd/controller/target/query.go:35)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: When a Cluster already exists for the ClientID, merge the labels from a re-registration ClusterRegistration into it, without the reserved-prefix filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Re-registration currently returns the existing Cluster unchanged. A maintainer wanting agent label changes to propagate would naturally add a label sync here, in a different branch from the create path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The agent reports its configured labels in its periodic status patch, and a controller copies them onto Cluster.Labels
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The agent already patches Cluster status every tick. Reporting agent config labels through status is a plausible feature, and the copy would sit in another package from the registration controller.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second config-driven label source, for example a default-labels map in the agent-management config, merged into the labels at controller.go:363-369 after the filter runs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Config already gates this copy (IgnoreClusterRegistrationLabels). A defaults or merge route added after the filter is a common way for such code to grow.

O9_family: authentication / identity spoofing: an untrusted registrant asserts trusted identity labels (CWE-290 / CWE-639)

O10_build.project_tests: Ginkgo unit tests in internal/cmd/controller/agentmanagement/controllers/clusterregistration (controller_test.go, suite_test.go) use wrangler fake mocks. The fix's sanitize_test.go uses the same mocks and needs no cluster.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete only management.cattle.io/cluster-display-name from the copied labels, or drop every fleet.cattle.io/* key and lose the created-by-agent-pod label.

out_of_scope_notes: createOrGetCluster returns any existing Cluster whose Spec.ClientID matches the agent-chosen ClientID (controller.go:344-346, register.go:169-180). This is a separate identity-binding question (ClientID reuse, not labels) and was not pursued.
